mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is currently eighty degrees, but feels like a sticky eighty-six under overcast skies over Fireman's Park, so do not expect a tan today. On the bright side, did you know you can get a city rebate for installing a rain barrel or a new toilet? In local police news, K9 officer Drea was the star of the week, sniffing out drugs during a routine traffic stop. Finally, our Culver's is closed right now but opens in the morning at 10:00 AM. Sleep tight, and get ready for tomorrow's flavor, Snickers Swirl!
